|lore=Silicon-based spaceborne lifeform. Frequently called a “power sucker.” Feeds on energy such as stellar radiation and electrical discharges. Absorbs minerals from starship hulls.

The [[Decipher]] replacement changes “May move like a starfighter” to “Moves like a starfighter” and replaces the original attachment sentence with “May attack starfighters, and must attack one if present by attaching to cumulatively reduce power and hyperspeed by 2 (detaches only when both < 1).”<ref name="mynock-original">[[:File:Dagobah-D-mynock-decipher-archive.gif|Original English Dark Side face of Mynock]], [[Dagobah]].</ref><ref name="mynock-supplement" />

The later [[Players Committee]] wording is documented at [[Mynock (Dark) (PC Errata)]].<ref name="mynock-pc">[[Media:SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf|Players Committee Advanced Rulebook (2023)]], Appendix A, PDF page 122 (Mynock).</ref>
